name: BloodLine SRA blood atlas
description: Public human blood RNA-seq samples from SRA/ENA (whole blood, PBMC, blood cells, plasma/serum RNA, platelets, cord blood, bone marrow) with all BioSample metadata, run accessions, and event labels: what happened to the donor (infection, vaccination, surgery, ...) and when, relative to the blood draw.

fields.access: open: reads downloadable from SRA/ENA; controlled: metadata public, reads need dbGaP approval
fields.labels.level: sample: read from the sample's own metadata; study: read from the study description (applies to all its samples)
fields.labels.delta_days: event time minus blood-draw time, days (negative = before the draw)
fields.labels.stage: student: decided by the trained classifier; teacher: by the local LLM; review_needed: undecided

licence: Metadata: as deposited in SRA/ENA/BioSample (public). Labels and harmonisation: CC BY 4.0.
source: NCBI SRA / BioSample and EMBL-EBI ENA, harvested by bloodline.sra_harvest
